name: Supchat Chatbot
author: supchat

sections.description:
supchat.pl is an AI-powered chatbot that answers your visitors’ questions automatically, 24 hours a day, based entirely on the content you provide. No hallucinations, no made-up information — only what you decide to share.

Once installed, simply enter your API key and the assistant starts working immediately. No coding skills required — anyone can set it up in minutes.

Key features:

  • Responds only based on content you provide
  • Full control over the assistant’s knowledge and behaviour
  • Fast, precise answers around the clock
  • Supports multiple domains under one account
  • Clean, intuitive management panel

Perfect for law firms, accounting offices, real estate developers, e-commerce stores, medical practices, and any business that communicates with customers through a website.

Free 7-day trial available at supchat.pl — no credit card required.

External Services

This plugin enqueues a remote JavaScript file from Supchat to display the chatbot widget on the frontend.

  • Service: Supchat Chatbot (https://supchat.pl)
  • Data sent: No personal data is sent automatically, but the script is loaded from our external servers to render the widget based on your API key.
  • Terms of Service: https://supchat.pl/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://supchat.pl/policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Supchat Chatbot and paste your API key.
  4. Save the changes – you’re all set!
sections.faq:
Where do I get my API key?

Log in to your account at supchat.pl, go to your dashboard and copy your API key from the settings section.

Do I need any technical knowledge to use this plugin?

No. Installation and configuration require no coding skills. Just paste your API key and the chatbot is ready to use.

What content does the chatbot use to answer questions?

The assistant responds only based on the content you provide in your supchat.pl account. It will never make up information or answer outside the scope you define.

Is there a free trial?

Yes. supchat.pl offers a 7-day free trial with no credit card required.

Does the plugin send any personal data?

No personal data is sent automatically. The plugin loads a remote JavaScript file from supchat.pl servers to render the chatbot widget based on your API key.
